p3_note: Drawing layer remains the shared SVG entry at app/index.html. M, E, and L were recomputed from the event log by topic3.metrics. Two simulated policies on one training instance are not an official seven-candidate front.

provisional_status.note: P1 generator output. Distribution values are the revised proposal's provisional assumptions, not a frozen design and not measured pilot results. Power and transfer-energy numbers are contract fields carried so the manifest can be read; this generator does not use them.

workload_distribution.offered_load_reference: mean discrete-uniform compute cycles divided by aggregate edge cycles per second, then divided by the offered-load target

seed_assignment.rule: Within a phase, seeds are grouped low, then medium, then high. Each seed is used once. Held-out uses the proposal's provisional 12 streams per intensity. Training and pilot use one stream per intensity so those splits are non-empty and disjoint; that count is not a frozen sample size.
